title: Run position changes when reopening a retained query

status.label: Reproduce retained-query placement
status.detail: A maintainer confirmed reproduction. Current placement already uses SearchBox height, so a total-results-height explanation is not established.

next_action.label: Measure activation and layout ordering
next_action.reason: Compare stable search-field coordinates before and after hiding a query with few results.

judgment.rationale: Screenshots, retained-query setup and an independent reproduction support local validation. Source inspection narrows investigation to activation/layout ordering rather than assuming the current code centers the whole results panel.
evidence: 0.83.0 report disables clear-previous-query, narrows results, hides Run and reopens it; screenshots show changed placement.
MainWindow.MoveToDesiredPosition uses SearchBox.ActualHeight, while MainWindow.xaml uses SizeToContent=Height and a separate ResultList.
The live issue is open and unassigned; no linked implementation appeared in the reviewed timeline/PR search.
judgment.recommended_action: Trace the activation/layout sequence on a current build and validate a stable search-field anchor before implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: A placement/layout correction is plausible, but the current source contains a search-field-based placement calculation and requires runtime discrimination.

proposed_fixes.title: Stabilize search-field position across retained-query activation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: activation calculates or saves placement before the retained-query layout and font/visibility updates settle, allowing SizeToContent or stale layout values to shift the search field. Current code does not simply center using total result-list height.
plan: Trace MainWindow.ViewModel_PropertyChanged, UpdatePosition and MoveToDesiredPosition in src/modules/launcher/PowerLauncher/MainWindow.xaml.cs, recording Top, monitor/DPI, SearchBox.ActualHeight and result count before/after layout.
If ordering is confirmed, calculate the search-field anchor after the relevant layout settles and prevent transient LocationChanged updates from overwriting remembered placement.
Preserve the existing PerMonitorV2 placement workaround and RememberLastLaunchLocation semantics; add activation regression coverage for zero, one and many retained results.
verification: With clear-previous-query disabled, compare search-field screen coordinates across repeated hide/reopen cycles with many, few and zero results.
Repeat with remember-position on/off, cursor/primary/focus monitor modes and mixed-DPI monitors; confirm no new repositioning or flicker.

confidence.rationale: The symptom is independently reproducible, but current source counterevidence rules out a simple total-window-height diagnosis; layout tracing is still required.

issue_context.summary: Run reopens at a different position after a retained query reduces its number of results, despite the desired stable search-field location.
known_information: Reported on 0.83.0 with clear-previous-query disabled and screenshots of the sequence.
A maintainer explicitly reproduced the report; the issue has Status-Reproducible.
The issue is open and has no assignee.
inferences: Activation/layout timing remains a possible cause; result count alone does not establish the responsible placement calculation.
issue_context.analysis: Public evidence is adequate for local reproduction. Preserve the positive reproduction evidence without claiming a confirmed fix or asking the reporter for the same steps.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the entire report, sole discussion comment, timeline and matching PR search.
Inspected upstream MainWindow.xaml and MainWindow.xaml.cs: separate search/results controls, SizeToContent and placement based on SearchBox.ActualHeight.

actions.label: Measure Run position across retained queries

reproduce.version: Current stable build; original and confirmed reproduction on 0.83.0
prerequisites: Disable clear-previous-query-on-launch; keep the active monitor and pointer location fixed.
steps: Open Run, issue a query with many results and record the search-field screen coordinates.
Extend the query until only a few results remain; record coordinates again.
Hide Run and reopen it without changing the query or monitor.
Compare coordinates and trace the placement/layout callbacks; repeat for zero results and remember-position on/off.
reproduce.expected_result: The search-field anchor remains stable across result counts and reopen cycles, subject only to the configured monitor/remember-position policy.

actions.label: Approve activation-layout fix investigation
actions.note: Do not replace the existing positioning workaround without reproducing the ordering defect.
